text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- President Hosni Mubarak was briefed by Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on the developments in Israeli-Palestinian negotiations, particularly on implementing the Hebron agreement, but also on the other phases of Israeli troop redeployment from the rest of the West Bank.
The conversation was positive, with the Israeli prime minister promising Mubarak he would give the process a strong push in the coming stage.

- Palestinian Airlines makes its first international trip to Saudi Arabia, taking pilgrims to perform the umra. It left from Port Said airport in Egypt because of Israel's refusal to let it take off from Gaza.
- Meetings with Egyptian, Arab, and foreign investors are being organised to encourage investment in the Toshka canal project to develop southern Egypt.
- Kamal Ganzouri to head the cabinet session discussing the cultivation of 3.4 million feddans of land in the New Delta project in southern Egypt.
- Mubarak speaks by telephone to the Syrian and Libyan leaders on the occasion of Ramadan.
